name: Max Speed Milford 2024

venue.name: Milford Primary School
venue.details: School hall at Milford Primary School accessible via Shakespeare Road or Otakau Road

information: Max Speed Milford 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering.
